name: sgolayfilt
comment: Sig y=sgolayfilt(x,order,framelen): Savitzky-Golay smoothing (order-2 quadratic, frame 5). Interior points use the central SG weights; the first/last (framelen-1)/2 points use the asymmetric edge polynomials (NOT steady-state). x=[3 1 4 1 5 9 2 6 5 3] -> y(1)=2.857143 (left edge), y(5)=5.342857 (interior), y(10)=3.914286 (right edge).
